sources.entry: Formbricks - Experience Management Suite built on the largest open source survey stack worldwide. Gracefully gather feedback at every step of the customer journey to know what your customers need. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Nodejs/Docker

summary.one_liner: Formbricks is a free, open source survey platform (self-hostable with Docker) for gathering in-app, website, link and email surveys from users and customers.
summary.what_it_does: Formbricks provides a survey platform for collecting feedback at points along the user journey through in-app, website, link and email surveys. It includes a no-code survey editor with several question types and a library of templates. Surveys can be targeted at specific user groups without changing the host application's code, and shareable link surveys can be created. Organization members can collaborate on surveys, and the README says Formbricks integrates with Slack, Notion, Zapier, n8n and others. The README also mentions prebuilt data analysis capabilities and a hosted cloud version at formbricks.com.
use_cases: Target surveys to specific user segments
Self-host a survey tool instead of a SaaS product
how_to_run: Self-hosting: see the self-hosting docs for Docker setup (referenced, not detailed in README)
Development: install Node.js, pnpm and Docker
pnpm go (runs pnpm db:up, creates .env from .env.example, and starts the Docker dev stack from docker-compose.dev.yml)
notable: Open source alternative to Qualtrics, per the README's tagline
In-app, website, link and email survey types from one platform
Core application is AGPLv3 and described as fully functional for surveys
Enterprise Edition code in apps/web/modules/ee requires a license key for extra features
Dev stack started with a single pnpm go command
caveats: Enterprise features need a paid Enterprise License Key, and the README says they are included in Docker images but locked
README does not offer white-labeling or reselling licenses
The README says code contributions are accepted only as an exception
summary.license: AGPL-3.0 (core); Enterprise Edition code under a separate license in apps/web/modules/ee
